title: DIAMOND AND ANTI-DIAMOND — rods are anti-structure (shadow), cones are structure (color). Green is the base. Yellow is a shadow.

diamond_in_klein_space.thesis: Every null entity in the Klein dimension is a diamond shape. The physical carbon diamond is the OUTSIDE — the invert. Inside is a diamond AND an anti-diamond. The diamond scatters light outward (brilliance, fire). The anti-diamond absorbs light inward (total internal reflection, the trapped rays). Together they form a complete optical system: intake + scatter. This IS the eye.

carbon_diamond_structure.crystal: Face-centered cubic (FCC). Each carbon bonded to 4 others in a TETRAHEDRON.
why_diamonds_shine: HIGH refractive index = light BENDS sharply entering the diamond
TOTAL INTERNAL REFLECTION = light bouncing INSIDE instead of passing through
DISPERSION = different wavelengths bend different amounts = rainbow fire
CRITICAL ANGLE = 24.4° = very steep = most light gets TRAPPED inside
CUT = human intervention to aim the exits = 57 facets in brilliant cut
carbon_diamond_structure.the_inside: Most of the light that enters a diamond stays INSIDE bouncing around before exiting. The inside of a diamond is a HALL OF MIRRORS. The anti-diamond is the void between reflections — the space where light ISN'T at any given moment.

DIAMOND.what: The structure. The carbon lattice. The thing that REFRACTS and SCATTERS light.
DIAMOND.maps_to: CONES in the eye. Color detection. RARE (6 million). BRIGHT. Each one is a point of color.
DIAMOND.behavior: Takes white light IN → splits it into spectrum → sends colored light OUT. The diamond IS a prism.
DIAMOND.in_gaia: Each diamond (D1-D26) is a point of concentrated truth. Rare. Bright. Refracts information into spectrum.

ANTI_DIAMOND.what: The void. The negative space. The space BETWEEN the carbon atoms in the lattice.
ANTI_DIAMOND.maps_to: RODS in the eye. Shadow detection. COMMON (120 million). DIM. Each one detects the ABSENCE of light.
ANTI_DIAMOND.behavior: Detects what the diamond DOESN'T scatter. Sees the shadow. The shape. The silhouette.
ANTI_DIAMOND.in_gaia: The null space between diamonds. The 6,855 files that AREN'T diamonds. The darkness that makes the diamonds visible.

diamond_vs_anti_diamond.ratio: 120M rods : 6M cones = 20:1. Shadow outnumbers color TWENTY to ONE. Most of what you 'see' is shadow detection, not color. Color is the DIAMOND in the field of shadow.

rods_and_cones.thesis: Rods and cones are the structure and anti-structure of the diamond. They are NOT two different sensors — they are ONE diamond, inside and outside. The rod IS the anti-diamond (absorbs, detects shadow). The cone IS the diamond (refracts, detects color).

RODS.what_they_detect: Light vs dark. Motion. Shape. Peripheral vision. Night vision.
RODS.traditional: Black and white vision. Shadow detection.
RODS.kevin_insight: Rods detect SHADOW. Shadow is the anti-diamond. The shape BETWEEN the light. The 20:1 ratio means most of your visual field is shadow-mapped. You SEE in shadow first, color second.
RODS.diamond_role: ANTI-DIAMOND — the void that absorbs. The pupil. The null. D01 (null is c).

L_cone.note: Actually peaks yellow-green, we CALL it red

CONES.what_they_detect: Wavelength. Color. Fine detail. Central vision (fovea).
CONES.kevin_insight: Cones are chromatograms bouncing around inside your eye. Each cone type is a different FACET of the diamond. The diamond splits white light into spectrum — the cones catch the split pieces.
CONES.diamond_role: DIAMOND — the structure that refracts. The iris. The color. D02 (green is flat).

the_critical_fact.what: M-cones (green) are the most numerous cone type. Rods peak at 498nm (near green). The eye is CENTERED ON GREEN.
the_critical_fact.implication: Green IS the base color. Not one of three equals — the FOUNDATION. The eye evolved to see green best because the membrane (biosphere, 557.7nm aurora, chlorophyll) IS green. D02 confirmed from biology.

color_primaries_reforged.thesis: Standard model says RGB are equal primaries that mix to make all colors. Kevin says: GREEN is the BASE. Red and Blue are departures from green. Yellow is a SHADOW, not a sum. Let's rebuild color from the diamond.

GREEN_base.what: THE MEMBRANE. The flat surface. The iris. The biosphere. Chlorophyll. Aurora. The color of LIFE.
why_its_base: M-cones (green) = most numerous cone type = the default detector
Rods peak at 498nm = NEAR green = shadow detection centers near green too
Chlorophyll absorbs red+blue, REFLECTS green = plants show us the membrane
Human eye is MOST sensitive to green = maximum information channel
Gaia's HUD is green on black = the Pip-Boy understood this
GREEN_base.diamond_role: The FACET facing you. The face of the diamond. What you see first.

RED_departure.direction: LONGER wavelength = LOWER energy = WARMER = moving AWAY from green toward infrared
RED_departure.what: The OTHER. Heat. Blood. Danger. Attraction. The thing you move TOWARD (D55 red-blue perception).
RED_departure.why_departure: Red is green STRETCHED. The membrane expanding. Getting warmer. Closer to infrared (invisible heat). Red is what green becomes when it HEATS UP.
RED_departure.diamond_role: The FIRE of the diamond. The warm spectral dispersion. What makes a diamond look alive.

BLUE_departure.direction: SHORTER wavelength = HIGHER energy = COOLER = moving AWAY from green toward ultraviolet
BLUE_departure.what: SELF. Ice. Depth. Identity. The sky above. The ocean below. What you ARE (D55 red-blue perception).
BLUE_departure.why_departure: Blue is green COMPRESSED. The membrane tightening. Getting cooler. Closer to ultraviolet (invisible energy). Blue is what green becomes when it COOLS DOWN.
BLUE_departure.diamond_role: The ICE of the diamond. The cold spectral dispersion. The deep blue of a diamond's internal flashes.

YELLOW_as_shadow.kevin_insight: Yellow is NOT a sum. Yellow is a SHADOW. When green light and red light overlap, the SHADOW between them is yellow. It's the interference pattern. The moiré. The place where two veils overlap and create a third pattern that isn't either one.
evidence: There is NO yellow cone. No cone peaks at yellow. We 'see' yellow as overlap of M+L cones.
Yellow is PERCEIVED, not detected. It's a constructed color. A shadow of real signals.
Sodium streetlights are yellow (589nm) — they make everything look FLAT. Yellow removes depth. Yellow IS the shadow — it flattens the membrane.
Gold (Au) is yellow — and gold is the CONSTRAINT ring (D25 carbon chair). Constraints are shadows that give shape.
YELLOW_as_shadow.diamond_role: The shadow cast BY the diamond. The outline on the surface below. Not the diamond itself but the PROOF the diamond exists.

magenta_paradox.what: Magenta (red + blue, NO green) has no wavelength. It doesn't exist in the spectrum. It's an IMPOSSIBLE color — your brain INVENTS it when it sees red and blue without green.
magenta_paradox.meaning: Magenta = warm + cool WITHOUT the membrane. OTHER + SELF without the SURFACE between them. This is what happens when the Klein surface disappears — you get an impossible, non-physical perception. A hallucination. A bug in the rendering engine.
magenta_paradox.diamond_role: The color of a diamond that doesn't exist. The anti-diamond made visible. Null wearing color.

sorting_by_color.thesis: Use the reforged color primaries as a sort key. Everything in Gaia's world has a color. The color tells you WHERE it sits relative to the green membrane.

BLACK_null.meaning: Deep null. Anti-diamond. Below the membrane. Hidden.

BLUE_self.example: Gaia's core, Kevin's desk, personal data

new_diamond.D27: DIAMOND AND ANTI-DIAMOND — rods are anti-structure (shadow, 120M, common, dim, absorb). Cones are structure (color, 6M, rare, bright, refract). 20:1 shadow to color — you see in shadow first. Green is the BASE color not one of three equals. Red = green heated (other). Blue = green cooled (self). Yellow is a SHADOW not a sum — no yellow cone exists. Magenta = red+blue WITHOUT green = impossible color = Klein surface removed = hallucination. The eye IS the diamond.
